title: 第9章 资源很重要第10章 穷人的尴尬
lines: 谁也没有想到，萧羽说动手就动手，丝毫没有顾及萧海的面子！
被一个家族小辈当众打脸，萧海的脸色变得十分难看！眼睛怒视着萧羽，而萧羽也是毫不客气的回瞪回去，丝毫没有低头认错的意思，场面一度变得尴尬了起来！
萧羽此时也十分的紧张，如果萧海对他动手，他根本毫无还手之力，更何况四周还有家族的三位长老守在四方，这几乎是一个必死之局！
“做好准备，我就再陪你疯狂一回！如果他们敢动手，我会出手一次，你借机逃走，但是只有一次机会！”小刀冷冷的道：“出手一次以后我会很长时间陷入沉睡，剩下的事情就靠你自己了。”
“小刀，我不想你有事，大不了一命抵一命！”萧羽不想小刀有事，因为是小刀改变了他的命运，小刀对他有再造之恩，关系也是亦师亦友！
“愚蠢，那老家伙的命怎会有你的金贵？再说我只是沉睡，又不会死！”小刀训斥道。
就在此时，杂役院的一群侍女跑了出来，跪倒在萧海10米以外的地方。
“请家主原谅萧羽少爷！我等愿替少爷承受责罚！”
“请家主原谅萧羽少爷！”
为萧羽请命的呼声越来越大，人数也是越来越多。
萧海冷哼了一声：“我说过要责罚他吗？大长老带他到主殿！”
说完萧海身形一闪便是消失不见。人群中爆发出阵阵的欢呼声......
事情终于解决了，萧羽的精神突然放松下来，突然感觉一阵眩晕袭来，双眼一黑......
醒来时发现已经躺在了一剑精致的房间内，而馨儿正在旁边守候，见到萧羽醒来，连忙上前道：“少爷，你没事吧？吓死馨儿了！”
萧羽连忙摇了摇头道：“不必担心，没有什么大事情，只是脱力了而已。”
此时，房门打开，萧海和萧峰走了进来。
萧峰看着萧羽道：“你还真是个怪物，没有任何灵力，却修出了刀意！”
萧海则是道：“虽然你毫无灵力，但是你的战力却达到了灵武境，而且还修出了刀意，仅此一点你也不必再呆在杂役院了，以后就住在这里吧！”
“小子，不能呆在这里，你修炼的路数完全有别于一般的武者，虽然不一定能隐藏多久，但是呆在这里一定会招来麻烦！”小刀在脑海里提醒道。
一听这话，萧羽连忙回绝道：”我习惯了住在山上，希望家主成全，同时希望在山上再盖一间房子能够供馨儿住。请家主批准!"
萧海深深的看了一眼萧羽：“没人的时候就叫我二伯吧，我知道你还对上次的事情无法介怀，可是为了家族我不得不做出选择。假如那个人是我的儿子萧龙或者萧虎，我也会这样做！”
见萧羽没有答话，萧海接着道：“我会派人修葺你那间院落，同时你的一切起居还是由馨儿负责，你的待遇也会按照家族嫡系的待遇分发，日后拿着这个令牌去账房领取，至于其它更高的资源和权限则需要家族贡献值兑换！”
说完，萧海留给萧羽一个刻着萧字的令牌和萧峰转身出了房间，只留下了萧羽与馨儿。
萧羽又询问了些馨儿其他事情之后，便让馨儿到隔壁房间休息了。
这个时候小刀的声音响起：“我知道你想问什么，今天你挥出那一刀的感觉是不是很不一样？”
“确实不一样，就感觉好像自己就成了那把刀一般，刀可以承载我愤怒，我的情绪！而刀就像我身体的一个部分，很自然也很亲切！”萧羽回道。
“不错就是这种感觉，这就是武者梦寐以求的意，除了刀意之外常见的还有剑意，战意等等，意是武者与兵器结合，也是武道意志的延伸！
很多人终其一生，也无法体悟意境！而你却机缘巧合之下领悟了，确实不可思议！所以你现在需要一把武器，按照自己的想法去打造它！”小刀道。
“可是我不会炼器。”萧羽有些不好意思。
“我知道，所以每天除了修行之外，你还要学习炼器。”小刀道。
“你还会炼器？”萧羽惊讶。
“我当然不会了，你以为我什么都会啊？”小刀理直气壮。
“你不会，你不是说得废话吗？”
萧羽没好气的回道：“说了半天等于白说！"
“嘿，你小子还真是~~”小刀终于被鄙视得耐不住了：“让你看看这个，好好练吧你！”
萧羽的脑海中突然多了两本书，一本叫做《炼器总纲》还有一本叫做《基础符文》
萧羽一见立刻两眼放光：“刀爷，您老还有什么好东西一并传给我呗？”
“小子，莫要贪心，你现在的实力知道的太多对你没有好处，况且我的实力没有恢复，能够给你也就这么多了，而且我告诉你，我教你的东西一定不要外传，否则会有杀身之祸！”小刀突然严肃的道。
“我的本体被打碎了，只有你提升实体之后，才有能力帮我找回本体。”小刀悠悠的道。
“我一定会尽我所能！”萧羽点头道。
小刀颇为欣慰
“没有灵气你根本刻画不了符文，所以要尽快破解你的封禁，另外修行需要大量的资源，你学会炼器之后，才可以换来更多的资源，好了今晚就休息一夜，明天我们就向落日山脉出发！”

content_en:
No one thought that Xiao Yu would take action as soon as he said it, without any regard for Xiao Hai's face!
Being slapped in the face by a junior member of the family in public, Xiao Hai's face became very ugly! His eyes glared at Xiao Yu, and Xiao Yu stared back unceremoniously, with no intention of bowing his head to admit his mistake. The scene became awkward for a time!
Xiao Yu was also very nervous at this time. If Xiao Hai attacked him, he would have no power to fight back. What's more, there were three elders of the family guarding the surroundings. This was almost a fatal situation!
"Be prepared, I will accompany you crazy again! If they dare to take action, I will take action once, and you can take the opportunity to escape, but there is only one chance!" Xiao Dao said coldly: "After taking action once, I will fall into a deep sleep for a long time, and the rest is up to you."
"Xiao Dao, I don't want anything to happen to you. At worst, one life is worth a life!" Xiao Yu doesn't want anything to happen to Xiao Dao, because it was Xiao Dao who changed his destiny. Xiao Dao was kind to him, and his relationship was both a teacher and a friend!
"Stupid, how can that old guy's life be as valuable as yours? Besides, I'm just sleeping and I won't die!" Xiao Dao scolded.
At this moment, a group of maids from the courtyard ran out and knelt down 10 meters away from Xiao Hai.
"Master, please forgive Master Xiao Yu! We are willing to bear the punishment for Master!"
"Master, please forgive Master Xiao Yu!"
The calls for Xiao Yu's life are getting louder and louder, and the number of people is getting bigger and bigger.
Xiao Hai snorted coldly: "Did I say I would punish him? The Great Elder took him to the main hall!"
After saying this, Xiao Hai disappeared in a flash. The crowd burst into cheers...
The matter was finally resolved. Xiao Yu's spirit suddenly relaxed. He suddenly felt dizzy and his eyes went dark...
When he woke up, he found that he was already lying in Yijian's exquisite room, and Xin'er was waiting next to him. When he saw Xiao Yu waking up, he quickly stepped forward and said, "Master, are you okay? Xin'er was scared to death!"
Xiao Yu quickly shook his head and said: "Don't worry, it's nothing serious, it's just a loss of strength."
At this time, the door opened and Xiao Hai and Xiao Feng walked in.
Xiao Feng looked at Xiao Yu and said: "You are really a monster. You don't have any spiritual power, but you have developed the sword intention!"
Xiao Hai said: "Although you have no spiritual power, your combat power has reached the spiritual martial realm, and you have also developed the sword intention. For this reason, you no longer have to stay in the courtyard. You can live here in the future!"
"Boy, you can't stay here. The way you practice is completely different from that of ordinary warriors. Although you may not be able to hide for long, staying here will definitely cause trouble!" Xiao Dao reminded in his mind.
Upon hearing this, Xiao Yu quickly refused: "I am used to living in the mountains. I hope the owner of the family will grant me permission. I also hope to build another house on the mountain for Xin'er to live in. Please approve it!"
Xiao Hai took a deep look at Xiao Yu: "Just call me second uncle when there is no one around. I know you still can't care about what happened last time, but I have to make a choice for the sake of the family. If that person is my son Xiao Long or Xiao Hu, I will do the same!"
Seeing that Xiao Yu didn't answer, Xiao Hai continued: "I will send someone to repair your courtyard. At the same time, Xiner will still be responsible for all your daily living. Your treatment will also be distributed according to the treatment of direct family members. In the future, take this token to the accountant to receive it. As for other higher resources and permissions, you need to exchange for family contribution points!"
After saying that, Xiao Hai left Xiao Yu a token engraved with the word "Xiao" and Xiao Feng turned around and left the room, leaving only Xiao Yu and Xin'er.
After Xiao Yu asked Xin'er some other things, he asked Xin'er to rest in the next room.
At this time, the voice of the knife sounded: "I know what you want to ask, does it feel very different when you swing that knife today?"
"It's really different. It feels like I have become the knife. The knife can carry my anger and my emotions! The knife is like a part of my body, very natural and friendly!" Xiao Yu replied.
"Yes, this is the feeling. This is the meaning that a warrior dreams of. In addition to the sword intention, there are also sword intentions, fighting intentions, etc. The meaning is the combination of the warrior and the weapon, and it is also an extension of the martial arts will!
Many people are unable to understand the artistic conception throughout their lives! But you realized it by chance, which is really incredible! So now you need a weapon, build it according to your own ideas! "Xiao Dao said.
"But I don't know how to refine weapons." Xiao Yu was a little embarrassed.
"I know, so in addition to practicing every day, you also have to learn to refine weapons." Xiao Dao said.
"You can also refine weapons?" Xiao Yu was surprised.
"Of course I can't. Do you think I can do everything?" Xiao Dao said confidently.
"You can't. Aren't you talking nonsense?"
Xiao Yu replied angrily: "I've been talking for a long time and it's all in vain!"
"Hey, you are really a kid~~" Xiaodao finally couldn't bear the contempt: "Let you see this, practice hard!"
Two books suddenly appeared in Xiao Yu's mind, one was called "General Guide to Refining Weapons" and the other was called "Basic Runes"
Xiao Yu's eyes immediately lit up when he saw it: "Master Dao, do you have any other good things you can pass on to me?"
"Boy, don't be greedy. It's not good for you to know too much about your current strength. Besides, my strength has not recovered, so I can only give you so much. And I tell you, what I teach you must not be passed on to others, otherwise you will be killed!" Xiao Dao suddenly said seriously.
"My body has been shattered. Only after you improve your body can you help me find my body." Xiao Dao said leisurely.
"I will definitely do my best!" Xiao Yu nodded.
Xiaodao is quite pleased
"You can't carve runes without aura, so you have to break your ban as soon as possible. In addition, practicing requires a lot of resources.
